what_this_is: Outside reviews of full assessments, and what we did with them. Bound to the content hash the reviewer actually read, because a review of an earlier draft is not a review of this one. Findings we rejected belong in draft_decisions.json with a reason, like every other finding we reject.

reviews.note: Rule 7: two-sided p = 0.053 quoted without naming the prespecified one-sided framework in the same sentence. Accepted and fixed with the reviewer's own wording.

reviews.reviewer: outside reviewer, arranged by Fred outside this environment
reviews.note: 3 findings + 1 unsourced suspicion, all accepted: false claim of an exhaustive comparative literature; 'none of these trials was powered for' OS, false — PALOMA-2 was; and a self-contradiction calling MONARCH 3's threshold conventional after saying it was .034.

reviews.reviewer: outside reader (post-publication), run by the operator outside this environment
reviews.note: Read the live page after publication. Found that the guideline lists all three drugs as preferred and the page never said so; that MONALEESA-2's p-value was called two-sided without a source; that two claims were broader than their evidence; and that the footer described a published page as a draft. All four accepted and fixed. Adjudicated in review/2026-08-29-post-publication.md.

reviews.reviewer: outside reviewer (independent, given the page and the review prompt only)
reviews.note: Both publish-blocking. Finding 1: the page said no null result existed; Pedersen et al. (Endoscopy, 3 June 2026) is one, and is now read in full and carried as its own section. Finding 2: the Lancet correction was described as unread; it was obtained, read, and its content disclosed.
